mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' THEN 'LEADER' ELSE config_subtype END type,subject_user_id user_id,CASE WHEN config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' THEN 3 WHEN config_subtype IN ('PRIMARY','TEMPORARY') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ordering FROM t_system_config WHERE ((config_type='ONCALL_SCHEDULE' AND scope_key=#{team} AND config_subtype IN ('PRIMARY','TEMPORARY','BACKUP') AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND NOW(3)>=effective_from AND NOW(3)<effective_to) OR (config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND scope_key=#{team} AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.primary')) AS UNSIGNED)=1 AND is_active=1)) ORDER BY ordering,subject_user_id
